summary: Duffel bag lost on the way to Cancun
story: I checked a duffel bag from Kansas City to Cancun on June 27 and it never turned up. Skylark looked for three weeks, then wrote to say it was lost and paid me $100. It was a beach week, so the bag was mostly shirts, shorts and swimsuits, all bought new in May, and my snorkel set. I spent the first two days of the vacation in the clothes I flew in. The receipts, the airline's report and their letter are attached.

documents.name: Skylark Airways property irregularity report
documents.content: Skylark Airways property irregularity report CUN-SK-19073. Passenger Jordan Ellis-Wright arrived Cancun CUN June 27, 2026 on SK 1440 from Kansas City. One checked bag, tag SK 402281, not delivered.

documents.name: Skylark Airways settlement letter
documents.content: Skylark Airways, July 20, 2026. Dear Jordan Ellis-Wright, we have been unable to find your bag, tag SK 402281, and now treat it as lost. We have paid $100.00 to your card in settlement of our liability.

documents.name: Receipts
documents.content: Plaza Outfitters, Kansas City, May 16, 2026. Three polo shirts at $65.00 each: $195.00. Two pairs of shorts at $60.00 each: $120.00. Two swimsuits at $85.00 each: $170.00. Leather sandals: $140.00. Total: $625.00. Midwest Dive and Swim, Kansas City, May 23, 2026. Snorkel mask and snorkel set: $70.00. Canvas duffel bag: $110.00. Total: $180.00. Card ending 3358, Jordan Ellis-Wright.
